items: Start your marketing strategy by defining your goals, unique selling points, budget and target guests, because every restaurant needs a different mix of tactics.
A clear brand identity, meaning your persona, tone and the feelings guests associate with you, helps you build a loyal following and more word-of-mouth business.
Keeping existing guests is cheaper than finding new ones, so an easy-to-join loyalty program that works online and offline gives you a direct channel for offers.
Use the feedback and customer data you collect online to understand the guest experience and target social media ads, including lookalike audiences built from your customer database.
Keep your website and social channels active, since guests check them before ordering or visiting, and use them to answer questions and complaints quickly.
